description: Cross-repo compatibility matrix (#466). A record kept for people and release notes: no CI in kpubdata, kpubdata-builder or kpubdata-studio reads it to gate a dependency range (#788). tests/unit/test_compatibility_json.py checks its shape and that the released-range row matches Builder's pin as docs/compatibility.md states it.
update_policy: Update on every kpubdata release. Builder/Studio link here, never copy.

matrix.note: 0.8.0 released 2026-09-30. Licence fields, schema(), provenance, validation report.
Cross-repo E2E (#282) runs against main branches

2026-09 release. Builder and Studio share one version (kpubdata ADR 0004); the kpubdata column is what uv.lock pinned, not the declared range (>=0.6.0,<0.7). kpubdata 0.7.0 is outside this release; builder main moved to >=0.7.0,<0.8 in builder#746, and the next release adds its own row.
